name: wybercloud-gcp-bridge
description: Cloud Run bridge for WyberCloud's Cloud SQL provisioning. Runs under the wybercloud-provisioner service account's ambient identity (no key file — the org enforces iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation), authenticates callers with a shared bearer secret, and wraps the Cloud SQL Admin API for the main app (hosted on Vercel, which has no ambient GCP identity of its own).
